title: patch endpoint
instruction: Add PATCH /items/:id. Accept a nonempty JSON object containing only name and/or quantity. name must be a nonblank string and is trimmed; quantity must be a nonnegative integer. Reject malformed JSON, empty objects, arrays, null, unknown fields and invalid values with 400. Validate the payload before looking up the id. A valid payload for a missing id returns 404. A name already used by another item returns 409; keeping the same name is allowed. Return 200 with the full updated item, preserving id and unspecified fields. A rejected patch must not change stored data. Keep existing endpoints unchanged.
